title: cdk-construct-lambda-function examples (all languages)
description:
Create runnable examples in packages/cdk-construct-lambda-function/examples/.

Scenarios:
- zip-minimal/ — filename/handler/runtime, ZIP deployment
- zip-comprehensive/ — all ZIP props: layers, environment vars, VPC config from bridge fixture, KMS, tracing, insights, reserved concurrency
- container-image/ — packageType IMAGE, imageUri (divergent: completely different deployment model, no handler/runtime)
- s3-deployment/ — s3Bucket/s3Key/s3ObjectVersion instead of filename (divergent: S3-sourced ZIP)
- with-vpc/ — vpcConfig using subnet/SG from bridge fixture (divergent: adds VPC attachments)
- with-efs/ — fileSystemConfig (divergent: adds EFS mount)

All 5 languages. Assertion tests in test/lambda-function-examples.test.ts.
